column1: # Per-sample arguments for scripts/build_v2_assemblies.py, and the inputs each
# sample needs before it can be built. Without this table the assemblies cannot
# be regenerated, because the arguments are not derivable from the inputs.
# strain    the strain identifier written into the FASTA headers
# replace   contigs whose sequence is substituted, as contig=source. A source of
#           "splice" means the contig is produced by scripts/lib/integrate_prophage.py
#           from the curated chromosome, the phage genomes and that sample's
#           integration-site table; "gapfill" means it is produced by filling
#           scaffold gaps from the assembly graph.
# drop      contigs removed from the assembly, semicolon separated
# note      why anything is dropped or replaced
# Contigs are dropped for three reasons and the note says which: "aphid" for host
# DNA that passed the contamination filter, "APSE fragment" for a partial phage
# sequence labelled as chromosome, and "APSE contig" for a phage genome that is
# represented as a prophage inside the chromosome instead.
sample

column5: contig_10/12/13/15 aphid; contig_22 APSE contig, spliced into contig_21
contig_15/16/17 aphid; contig_03/04/14 APSE fragments; contig_05 APSE contig, spliced into contig_02 and contig_11
contig_05 APSE contig, spliced into contig_02 at two sites
